title: IEANTN (Terence Tao): Büthe (2016) Partial RH Explicit Prime Bounds
description: Six verbatim open explicit prime-counting theorems under partial Riemann hypothesis assumptions from Terence Tao's IEANTN (teorth/IEANTN@cd9c2dd3, Apache-2.0): Büthe (2016) Theorem 2 Schoenfeld-strength bounds for ψ(x), θ(x), π*(x) - li(x), and π(x) - li(x) within range 4.92√(x / log x) ≤ T, plus Theorem 1 relative-error bounds for ψ(x) across Tables 1 and 2. Every frozen definition file is SHA-256 identical to upstream (0 custom axioms).

tasks.title: Büthe (2016) Theorem 2: |ψ(x) - x| ≤ √x (log x)² / (8π) under partial RH
tasks.description: Prove `Buthe2016.v1.challenge_theorem_2_psi`: if `RiemannHypothesisUpTo T`, then `|ψ(x) - x| ≤ √x (log x)² / (8π)` for every `x > 59` with `4.92 √(x / log x) ≤ T`.

tasks.title: Büthe (2016) Theorem 2: |θ(x) - x| ≤ √x (log x)² / (8π) under partial RH
tasks.description: Prove `Buthe2016.v1.challenge_theorem_2_theta`: if `RiemannHypothesisUpTo T`, then `|θ(x) - x| ≤ √x (log x)² / (8π)` for every `x > 599` with `4.92 √(x / log x) ≤ T`.

tasks.title: Büthe (2016) Theorem 2 (7.1): |π*(x) - li(x)| ≤ √x log x / (8π) under partial RH
tasks.description: Prove `Buthe2016.v1.challenge_theorem_2_li_minus_riemann_pi`: if `RiemannHypothesisUpTo T`, then `|riemannPrimeCounting x - li x| ≤ √x log x / (8π)` for every `x > 59` with `4.92 √(x / log x) ≤ T`.

tasks.title: Büthe (2016) Theorem 2 (7.2): |π(x) - li(x)| ≤ √x log x / (8π) under partial RH
tasks.description: Prove `Buthe2016.v1.challenge_theorem_2_li_minus_pi`: if `RiemannHypothesisUpTo T`, then `|primeCounting x - li x| ≤ √x log x / (8π)` for every `x > 2657` with `4.92 √(x / log x) ≤ T`.

tasks.title: Büthe (2016) Theorem 1 Table 1: relative |ψ(x) - x| ≤ δ₀ x bounds up to T = 3.061·10¹⁰
tasks.description: Prove `Buthe2016.v1.challenge_theorem_1_table1`: for every row `(b, T, δ₀)` of Table 1, `RiemannHypothesisUpTo T` implies `|ψ(x) - x| ≤ margin 0 * δ₀ * x` for all `x ≥ exp b`.

tasks.description: Prove `Buthe2016.v1.challenge_theorem_1_table2`: for every row `(b, T, δ₀)` of Table 2, `RiemannHypothesisUpTo T` implies `|ψ(x) - x| ≤ margin 0 * δ₀ * x` for all `x ≥ exp b`.
